akrapovic-racing-line-titanium-yamaha-r9.d: This brand-new complete exhaust system for the Yamaha R9 follows the look of the Akrapovič exhaust systems for the Yamaha R6, R7, and R1, with a design similar to the Akrapovič exhausts used in the World Supersport Championship. A high-grade lightweight titanium muffler outer sleeve and end cap is combined with a stainless-steel link pipe, headers, and pre-muffler. Developed to fit the motorcycle’s lines, a pre-muffler is positioned under the body and hidden by the lower fairings, and the muffler exits on the right side for a racing appearance. A catalytic converter is incorporated within the system to meet EC/ECE type approval (Euro 5+). It is supplied with an aluminium muffler bracket, and it delivers a deep and sporty sound. Akrapovič engineers focused on throttle response during the development process and performance gains in the mid and high rev range. There are power and torque increases of 2.2 kW (3.0 hp) at 10,000 rpm and 2.6 Nm at 9,500 rpm, respectively, when tested on the Akrapovič dyno and compared to a Yamaha R9 equipped with a standard stock exhaust system. The plug-and-play installation means no remapping is required.

akrapovic-racing-line-ss-suzuki-gsx-8s-r.d: Inspired by the concept shown at EICMA in 2024, this exhaust has been designed to seamlessly integrate with the bike's lines. Constructed in one piece from high-grade stainless steel and shaped through the use of high-end technology, with the catalytic converter welded inside the muffler. It is finished with a handmade carbon-fibre cover, which incorporates the outlet with a honeycomb exhaust protection and an Akrapovič logo in red and white. If features plug-and-play installation with no remapping required. Focus was placed on optimal throttle response and performance during development, which has resulted in a power increase of 1.8 kW (2.5 hp) at 9,500 rpm and a torque boost of 1.4 Nm at 5,500 rpm when compared to a Suzuki GSX-8S with a standard stock exhaust system and tested on the Akrapovič in-house dyno. Weight is reduced by 29.1% (2.2 kg) compared to the standard stock exhaust system. Delivering a deep and sporty sound, this full system is EC/ECE type approved and Euro 5+ compliant. It has been designed so that it can also be mounted in combination with the original Suzuki soft sided case set.

falco-sko-viky-dam-burgundy.d: Viky är en tålig mc-stövel med överdel i slitstark Micro-Synth och vattentät High-Tex membran som håller dig torr under alla väderförhållanden. Förstärkningar vid tå och häl tillsammans med D3O®-förstärkta ankelskydd ger ett säkert skydd. Stöveln har både snörning och dragkedja för en säker och justerbar passform. Den slitstarka dubbelkomponents vulkaniserade gummisulan ger stabilt grepp och lång hållbarhet. Funktioner i korthet: • Micro-Synth med vattentät High-Tex membran • Förstärkningar vid tå och häl för extra skydd • D3O®-ankelskydd för effektiv stötdämpning • Snörning och dragkedja för enkel och säker passform • Dual-komponents vulkaniserad gummisula med högt grepp Viky – pålitligt skydd och komfort oavsett väder.

falco-sko-ace-brun.d: Ace är en tålig och bekväm sko med en överdel i slitstark Micro-Synth och ett vattentätt High-Tex-membran som håller fötterna torra i alla väder. Stöveln har en praktisk kombination av snörning och dragkedja för enkel på- och avtagning samt en säker passform. Den slitstarka vulkaniserade dubbelkomponentssulan ger både bra grepp och hållbarhet.
